raw_segments.text: A father to me, and thou hast created a mother and two brothers.
But oh scorn gone, they went hence so soon as they were born, and so I am awake.
Poor wretches that depend on greatness favor, dream as I have done, wake and find nothing.
But alas, I swerve, many dream not to find, neither deserve, and yet are steeped in favors.
So am I that have this golden chance, and know not why.
Be not, as is our fangled world, a garment nobler than that it covers.
Let thy effects so follow to be most unlike our courtiers, as good as promise.
